name: app.lingostories/lingostories
title: LingoStories
description: Short graded stories and grammar lessons for learning 12 languages, levels A1 to B1.

tools.name: find_story
tools.description: Find a free short story on LingoStories for learning English, German, Norwegian, Swedish, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Polish at CEFR level A1, A2 or B1, on a topic (travel, food, work, family, fairy tales, mystery and more). Returns stories with an English summary, the first sentences in the language with English translation, and a link to read with native audio and click-to-translate on every word, plus comprehension questions. No account needed.

tools.name: grammar_lesson
tools.description: Find a free grammar lesson on LingoStories for English, German, Norwegian, Swedish, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Polish (A1 to B1): explanation with examples, tables and exercises, linked to sentences from real stories. Give the language and a topic (e.g. "past tense", "articles", "word order"), or no topic for the list of lessons.
